documents.t: bal_competitions(*, return_parsed: 'bool' = True, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False, **kwargs: 'Any') -> 'Union[pl.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, Dict]' Every competition of the BAL Genius org, with its END-year season. Basketball Africa League (men's); season rule: calendar year (BAL 2025 = 2025); 2023 lists two competitions, so pass comp_id. Convenience wrapper: a thin binding of genius_competitions to this competition, minted from the competition registry (tools/codegen/basketball_competitions.yaml). Read before use: Access: the Genius hosts publish no robots.txt and no terms. CloudFront refuses datacenter IPs on the LiveStats and hosted hosts: from a server set the optional GENIUS_PROXY environment variable to an http(s) proxy URL (it is never logged or printed). The wrappers space requests at least one second apart and read only the Genius hosts; keep crawls slow and incremental. Some league sites (the NZ NBL) forbid AI crawlers in their own robots.txt, which does not cover these hosts. Parameters Returns A polars/pandas DataFrame by default; the chooser page record (dict) plus _request (the org asked for) when return_parsed=False. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.genius import bal_competitions bal_competitions()
